Name: FIRST STEPS
Said: One down. The tower does not notice, but you do.
Everything above this is the same thing again, harder.

Name: TAUGHT
Said: Bob has said his piece and gone back to wherever he waits.
Nothing he told you was untrue. Nothing he told you was all of it.

Name: FLINCH
How: Wear a defence all the way down to a Flinch.
Said: A guard worn down to a twitch, and it still costs nothing.
Free is a kind of strong, if you are counting cards rather than shields.

Name: SPECTRUM
How: Attack with four elements in one turn.
Said: Four colours in one breath.
The hand ladder does not pay for this. Do it anyway.

Name: ELEMENTALIST
How: Attack with all five elements in one turn.
Said: Fire, ice, lightning, earth and arcane, all in the same swing.
Every relic you own fired at once, and every one you do not sat out.

Name: WEAPONMASTER
How: Attack with a stab, a slash and a crush in one turn.
Said: Three ways of hitting, none of them wasted.
A rung the ladder used to have, and could never price.

Name: ARSENAL
How: All three attack forms and a defence, in one turn.
Said: Everything the deck can be, on the table at once.
Four forms. There is no fifth.

Name: PRISM
How: Five attacks of one form or one card, in all five elements.
Said: One shape, every colour.
The narrowest hand in the game and the widest, at the same time.

Name: FIFTH FLOOR
How: Climb as far as the fifth floor.
Said: Four floors below you, and the stairs keep going.
Whatever you came in wearing, you are not wearing it now.

Name: THREE HUNDRED CUTS
Said: Three hundred of them, and the edge has not dulled.
You have a favourite. That is fine. It is also readable.

Name: STRUCK TWO HUNDRED
Said: Two hundred Bashes. The middle rung of the crushes, over and over.
Nothing fancy has ever needed to be.

Name: TINY BUT FIERCE
How: Play five free attacks of the same card in one turn.
Said: Five of them, and the round cost you nothing at all.
A turn is bounded twice — by what you can pay and by how many cards you can put down. You found the second wall.

Name: GODSLAYER
How: Play five 4 AP attacks of the same card in one turn.
Said: Five of the heaviest thing the deck can become, in one breath.
Twenty points of action out of a budget that was never meant to stretch that far.
Whatever that was, it was not a duel.

Name: INVULNERABLE
How: Stand behind ten shields at once.
Said: Ten of them, and a turn can only throw five.
Five more than anything in the tower can reach. You bought the ones nobody could take.
